#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 50s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — her body is covered in applied metallic leaf in 3 different colours at once, each colour claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 44% of the way down her figure from the top and about 69% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries applied BRIGHT SILVER metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright BRIGHT SILVER sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied COPPER metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright COPPER sheen filling every gap. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries applied CHAMPAGNE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright CHAMPAGNE sheen filling every gap. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring leaf colours dissolve into each other, flakes from one thinning out as flakes from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one colour, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots covered in the same leaf colours at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
